walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Computer Science specification.

Cyber Security & Ethics appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Cyber Security & Ethics in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Cyber Security & Ethics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
